Invited Ada (p_ID) as admin.
Invite link:  fleetd://pair?hub=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A4790&code=CODE
Code:         CODE  (single use, valid until TIME)
Workspace:    http://127.0.0.1:4790

Send Ada the link, or the code and workspace address to enter in the fleetd app. The device it pairs is theirs.
Take it back with `fleetd invite revoke inv_ID`.

Only this computer reaches http://127.0.0.1:4790, so Ada can't join from theirs yet. Give the workspace an address their computer reaches, its tailnet or LAN address: on the workspace's machine, run `fleetd init --listen <ip>:<port> --url http://<name>:<port>` (Settings › Workspace › Setup › Where the workspace listens), then send them a new invite.
